recipes.title: Cheesy Beef Dipping Burritos

items.i: chicken broth (90 g plus 30 g if needed)
low-carb tortillas (La Banderita Carb Counter, 60 cal)
light string cheese sticks, frozen, halved lengthwise

steps: Make the sauce
Blend the yogurt, cottage cheese, Taco Bell sauce and taco seasoning until smooth. Chill.
Crust the beef
Heat the pan to 7/10. Flatten the beef, cut it in half and leave it until it browns up the sides, flip, then break it up while still slightly pink.
Season
Add the taco seasoning packet and mix, then 90 g chicken broth and let the beef soak it up.
Make it cheesy
Turn down to 3/10. Stir in the Laughing Cow wedges, shredded cheese and nutritional yeast until creamy, adding up to 30 g more broth if it's too thick. Let it cool a little.
Fill
Spread an eighth of the beef in the middle of each tortilla and lay a string cheese half on each side.
Fold flat
Fold in the sides, then the bottom and top flaps, pulling tight, and press flat into a rectangle rather than rolling.
Air fry
Spray and air fry 4 at a time at 400 °F for 4 minutes, flipping after 2. Serve with the sauce.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the video's audio and on-screen captions. Macros (per burrito) are from the creator's on-screen nutrition card. They freeze well. Full recipes are in the creator's free recipe book (linked).

recipes.title: Nashville Hot Honey Chicken Crunchwrap

items.i: water (20 g + 20 g for the slurry)
½ tsp each cayenne, paprika, black pepper, sea salt, garlic powder and brown sugar
chicken breast, flattened and cut into 4 patties
Nashville seasoning: cayenne, paprika, black pepper, sea salt, garlic powder, brown sugar

steps: Honey slaw
Mix the yogurt, mayo, vinegar, pickle juice, honey, salt and pepper until smooth, then toss in the cabbage and carrots. Chill.
Hot honey

Put the syrup, honey, vinegar, butter, 20 g water and spices in a pot, then heat on 5/10, stirring until it simmers. Take off the heat, stir in the cornstarch mixed with 20 g water and keep stirring until thick.
Prep the chicken
Flatten the chicken and cut out 4 even patties (cook the offcuts too).
Coat
Whisk egg whites with Frank's. Mix the flour, cornstarch, baking powder and Nashville seasoning. Dip each patty in the wet, then press into the dry, getting into every crevice.
Air fry
Spray until no flour shows and air fry at 400 °F for 9 minutes, flipping and spraying after 5. Brush with warm hot honey.
Build

Soften a tortilla in warm water, cut one slit from the middle to the edge, then fill the four quarters with chicken, slaw, pickle-brine sauce and 6 pickles. Fold each quarter over the next and press shut.
Crisp
Spray and air fry at 400 °F for 5 minutes (a ramekin on top keeps it shut). Slice in half.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the audio and on-screen captions. Macros (per crunchwrap) are from the creator's on-screen nutrition card. Spice amounts in the chicken coating are estimates.

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Bacon Ranch Pinwheels

items.i: ranch dip mix, to season the chicken

steps: Ranch
Blend the ranch ingredients 60–90 seconds until smooth. Chill.
Bacon
Bake the bacon at 400 °F for 15–17 minutes, drain on paper towels and chop.
Chicken
Pat the chicken dry, flatten, season both sides with ranch mix, spray and air fry at 400 °F for 9–10 minutes. Rest 10 minutes, then dice finely.
Filling
Mix the chicken, bacon, yogurt, Laughing Cow, mozzarella, ranch mix, pickles and green onion, breaking up the cheese wedges.
Roll
Spread a quarter of the filling over each tortilla, leaving an inch at the edges. Trim the round edges off, roll up tightly and cut into 6 pinwheels.
Bake
Put the pinwheels in a muffin tin and bake at 400 °F for 14–16 minutes until crispy underneath. Serve with the ranch.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the audio and on-screen captions. Macros are from the creator's card (57 cal per pinwheel); a serving here is 4 pinwheels.

recipes.title: Crispy Jalapeño Popper Chicken Pockets

items.i: sea salt, garlic powder, onion powder
Laughing Cow light cheese wedges (or cream cheese)
flour and cold water, for the 'glue'
avocado oil spray and garlic powder

steps: Sauce
Blend all the sauce ingredients until smooth. Chill (keeps 7–10 days).
Chicken
Season the tenders with blackened seasoning, spray and air fry at 400 °F for 9 minutes. Dice finely.
Roast the jalapeños
Air fry the jalapeños at 400 °F for 5–7 minutes, then remove stems and seeds (keep seeds for more heat) and dice.
Filling
Mash the yogurt, Laughing Cow, jalapeños and ranch mix with a fork, then mix in the mozzarella, chicken, black beans, corn and pico.
Form cones
Mix flour and water into a paste. Fold each tortilla half into a cone, gluing the seam.
Fill and seal
Fill each cone without overstuffing, glue the top flap shut and crimp the edge with a fork.
Air fry
Spray, sprinkle with garlic powder and air fry at 400 °F for 4–5 minutes. Serve with the sauce.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the audio and on-screen captions. Macros (per pocket) are from the creator's on-screen nutrition card. He made 8 pockets with half the filling, so the full batch makes about 16. Jalapeño and yogurt amounts in the filling, and the honey/mustard in the sauce are estimates. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Stuffed Pocket Pizza
steps: Chicken
Pat dry, flatten, season with ranch mix, spray and air fry at 400 °F for 9–10 minutes. Rest 10 minutes and dice finely.
Buffalo dip
Mix the chicken with the Buffalo sauce, Laughing Cow, mozzarella, nutritional yeast, red onion and green onion.
Fill
Wet each tortilla half, add a scoop of dip in a triangle shape, fold one side then the other over it and press completely flat.
Bake
Preheat a sheet pan in the oven. Spray it, lay the 6 pockets apart, spray the tops and bake at 400 °F for 8–10 minutes until golden.
Top
Push the slices together into a pizza, add 20 g pizza sauce per slice and the mozzarella, then broil until the cheese is golden.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the audio. Macros (per slice) are from the creator's on-screen nutrition card. Rinsing shredded mozzarella removes the starch so it melts and stretches better.

recipes.title: Meal Prep Freezer Breakfast Burritos
steps: Sauce
Mix the Buffalo sauce and sugar-free syrup.
Veggies
Add the frozen peppers and onions to a hot pan (7/10), cover until softened, then uncover and sauté until browned.
Meat
Add the turkey and beef, flatten and let a crust form, cook 2 more minutes, then break up and mix with the veggies and taco seasoning.
Make it creamy
Stir in the cottage cheese and nutritional yeast and keep mixing 10–15 minutes until thick (lower to 4–5/10 if it catches). Cool in a bowl.
Eggs
In the same pan on 5/10, add the egg whites and eggs and keep the spatula moving in circles 3–4 minutes until just fluffy. Remove, then salt. Cool.
Roll
Fill each tortilla with a sixth of the meat and eggs and roll up tightly. Wrap in foil and freeze.
Reheat
Unwrap, wrap in a paper towel and microwave 2½ minutes, then air fry at 360 °F for 10–12 minutes until crispy. Serve with the maple Buffalo sauce.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the audio and on-screen captions. Macros (per burrito) are from the creator's on-screen nutrition card. The veg and sauce amounts are estimates. A low-carb tortilla cuts the calories further.

recipes.title: High-Protein Pizzadilla

items.i: burrito tortilla (or low-carb to save ~100 cal)
oregano, basil and red pepper flakes
turkey pepperoni slices (17 inside, 9 on top)

steps: Egg layer
Pour the egg whites into a sprayed pan and lay the tortilla on top. Cover until the egg whites set.
Flip
Carefully flip so the egg side is up.
Fill
Spread pizza sauce over half, season well with oregano, basil and chili flakes, and add mozzarella and 17 pepperoni. Fold in half while the bottom crisps.
Top and bake
Top with more sauce, mozzarella and 9 pepperoni, then bake at 450 °F until golden. Cut into 4 slices.
recipes.notes: Amounts come from the audio and on-screen captions. Macros (for the whole pizzadilla) are from the creator's on-screen nutrition card. The sauce amount is an estimate. The egg whites add about 22 g protein and you can't taste them; use 100 g if you prefer.
